exports.name: Session
signatures:
interface InspectorSession<M extends InspectorSessionEvents = InspectorSessionEvents> {
  readonly connected: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  connect(): void
  post<T extends unknown = unknown>(method: string, cb: (err: Error, result: T) => void): Promise<T>
  destroy(): void
  addListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  addOnceListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  prependListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  prependOnceListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  removeListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  removeAllListeners<E extends keyof M>(name?: E): this
  on<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  once<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  off<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  emit<E extends keyof M>(name: E, ...args: M[E]): boolean
  listeners<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E], R>
  rawListeners<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E], R>[]
  eventNames(): (keyof M)[]
  listenerCount<E extends keyof M>(name: E): number
  getMaxListeners(): number
  setMaxListeners(n: number): void
}
exports.description: Dispatches messages to the V8 inspector back-end and receives responses and notifications, mirroring Node's `inspector.Session`. `onpaused` is called whenever the debugger pauses; return `true` to keep the pause, or a falsy value to resume immediately.

params.name: onpaused
params.description: Called whenever the debugger pauses; return `true` to keep the pause, or a falsy value to resume immediately (the default resumes).

members.name: connect
members.description: Connects the session to the inspector back-end, enabling `post()` to send messages. A no-op if already connected or destroyed.

members.name: connected
members.description: Whether the session is connected and not destroyed.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Destroys the session, releasing its inspector back-end handle. A no-op if already destroyed.

members.name: destroyed
members.description: Whether the session has been destroyed.

members.name: post
signatures: post<T extends unknown = unknown>(method: string, cb: (err: Error, result: T) => void): Promise<T>
post<T extends unknown = unknown>(method: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>, cb?: (err: Error, result: T) => void): Promise<T>
members.description: Posts `method` (with optional `params`) to the inspector back-end. Resolves or calls `cb` with the result, or with an `Error` if the inspector returns one.

members.name: Session.InspectorSessionEvents
members.description: The events a `Session` emits: `inspectorNotification` for every inspector notification, and one event per inspector protocol method name (for example `'Debugger.paused'`) carrying the same message.

members.name: Session.SessionMessage
members.description: An inspector protocol notification: the `method` name and its `params`.

  address(): TCPSocketAddress

  ref(): this
  unref(): this
  addListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this

  prependListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this

  removeListener<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this

  on<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  once<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  off<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E], R>): this
  emit<E extends keyof M>(name: E, ...args: M[E]): boolean
  listeners<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E], R>
  rawListeners<E extends keyof M, R>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E], R>[]
  eventNames(): (keyof M)[]
  listenerCount<E extends keyof M>(name: E): number
  getMaxListeners(): number
  setMaxListeners(n: number): void
}
exports.description: A WebSocket server exposing a `Session` for remote debugging, compatible with Chrome DevTools and mirroring the endpoints Node's `--inspect` exposes (`/json/list` and a WebSocket debugger URL).

members.name: Server
signatures: new Server(port: number, host: string, opts?: InspectorServerOptions)

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `path` is the script URL reported to DevTools and defaults to `require.main.path`.

members.name: address
members.description: Returns the address the server is listening on.

members.name: close
members.description: Stops the server from accepting new connections, destroys existing connections and the underlying debugger session, and calls `cb` once closed.

members.name: listening
members.description: Whether the server is currently listening for connections.

members.name: ref
members.description: Marks the server so the event loop won't exit while it's listening.

members.name: Server.InspectorServerEvents
members.description: The events an inspector `Server` emits: `listening`, once the server starts listening.

members.name: Server.InspectorServerOptions
members.description: Options for `Server`: `path`, the entry-point URL reported to DevTools as the URL of the inspected script.

members.name: unref
members.description: Unmarks the server so the event loop can exit even while it's listening.

exports.name: HeapSnapshot
signatures:
interface InspectorHeapSnapshot {
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
}

params.name: session
params.description: The connected `Session` to take the snapshot over.
